translations.web: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
translations.bsb: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
translations.kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
